LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

OriginProfile.description: The publication profile an approved origin implements.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

description: The origins the operator approves for one index.

apiVersion.description: The format and version of this file.

additionalProperties.description:
One approved origin: a provider whose public description the index
collects.

catalogUrl.description:
Exact production HTTPS URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
Loopback HTTP is a development exception `discoveryctl` accepts only
with `--allow-loopback`, not part of this production authoring schema.

enabled.description: Whether `discoveryctl package` collects this origin. Absent, it does.

origins.description: One to 128 approved origins, keyed by origin id and held in id order.

propertyNames.description: The origin's name in this project, unique among its origins.

title: Registry Discovery approved origins
